name: Karn, Gilded Guardian
description: An Echoverse golden golem given an artificial spark by Mishra, who forged Mirrodin and guards it as shepherd.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Karn forges Mirrodin, a plane of peace and prosperity.
timeline.quote: He forged Mirrodin, a shining metal plane of peace and prosperity that would never know about the horrors of war.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: Memnarch is a confidant of Karn.
relations.quote: Memnarch is the warden of Mirrodin and a confidant of Karn.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
